1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

292-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
292-progress.text: That drunk Fitzsimmons sent you to me? Well, you can tell him I don't have any extra ale. He's going to have to panhandle someone else!
292-progress.title: The Eye of Paleth

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

87318-accept.name: Corma Villard
87318-accept.text:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318-accept.title: Hearts of the Lost

87318-complete.name: Essene Villard
87318-complete.text:
Corma sent you? That's great news!

When the Dark Irons ambushed us, we were separated, and I hit my head and couldn't tell which direction I was going. I wound up here and I've been living out of the supplies in my bag for the last few days. Now that you've made it past the Dark Irons, though, it may be possible for me to make my escape.

I just have to gather my things and take a moment to catch my senses, and I'll figure out a way to escape!

She never gave up on me. What a lovely heart.
87318-complete.title: Hearts of the Lost

87491-complete.name: Roggo Harlbarrow
87491-complete.text:
That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!

Glad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!
87491-complete.title: Spark of Freedom

88756-complete.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
88756-complete.text:
Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire.

Now we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry!

Thanks!
88756-complete.title: Bring Back a Bang

88756-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
88756-progress.text: This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on!
88756-progress.title: Bring Back a Bang

88757-accept.name: Essene Villard
88757-accept.text:
While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!

It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!

If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.
88757-accept.title: Accessories of the Lost

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven
